components.name: evidence session/bundle
components.mutability: immutable after seal (payload_ref nullable for redaction; payload contents off-chain)
components.signing_boundary: one Ed25519 signature over raw batch_root bytes; signedShape excludes payload_ref
components.verification_boundary: public key only; verifyBundle reads signatures[0] only
components.credentials: private key (PEM/env) to sign; none to verify
components.deterministic_offline: seal sync/offline; ts_utc + signed_at_utc default wall-clock (ts_utc overridable)
components.portability: portable JSON; HMAC mode NOT portable

components.name: evidence bundle JSON Schema
components.mutability: frozen (event enum at 13; code EVENT_TYPES has 18 — drift)
components.verification_boundary: verifyBundle does NOT validate against this schema

components.name: canonicalization
components.consumer: session hashing, manifest signing, python parity

components.name: Ed25519 keygen CLI
components.mutability: keys immutable; rotation by convention; revocation ABSENT
components.portability: public key portable; private never packaged

components.name: attestation envelope
components.signing_boundary: pipe-joined payload; optional fields appended untagged when truthy (stripped optional field still verifies)
components.verification_boundary: public key (ed25519) or shared secret (hmac dev-only)

components.name: CLI verifier
components.schema: exit 0 verified / 1 failed / 2 usage / 3 io / 4 profile-non-conformant; failure triple {seq,reason,impact}

components.name: browser verifier
components.schema: offline WebCrypto Ed25519; trust levels SELF_SIGNED..LOG_ANCHORED
components.verification_boundary: paste bundle + public PEM; verify-the-verifier via signed manifest

components.name: signed release manifest (KEY REUSE TARGET)
components.schema: shadow-verify-manifest-v1 {manifest_version, verifier_version, commit_sha, built_at, canonicalization_version, supported_profiles, assets[]{path,sha256}, release_public_key_fingerprint, signature}
components.verification_boundary: verifyManifestSignature reasons: MANIFEST_MALFORMED|MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_MISSING|MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_FAILED|OK; checkAssets one-way (extra files NOT detected)
components.portability: the package-manifest pattern to extend (new version)

components.name: flow export CLI (presentation member)
components.signing_boundary: none by design (bound via package manifest hash instead)

components.name: runOneShot (NOT the package path)
components.schema: shadow-lens-session/1.0; scenes generated_from session lineage (not shadow-flow-export/1.0)
components.producer: HTTP handler; writes no files (per-request in-memory store)
components.signing_boundary: env keys or ephemeral demo key (labeled)
components.network: live analyze needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; fixture mode offline
components.portability: session lineage; future package member candidate

components.name: acceptance package generator (unsigned-manifest precedent)
components.schema: MANIFEST.json {generated_from, build_commit, contract_version, record_integrity, tamper_detected, flow_zip, files[]} — no hashes, no signature
sensitive_fields: none (transcript pinned free of PRIVATE KEY)

components.name: human review / approval representation
components.schema: human_approval event (actor user); payload {decision: approved|modified|rejected, reviewer_id?, override_rationale (required for modified/rejected)}
components.mutability: event immutable; payload redactable via payload_ref

components.name: trust posture
components.schema: verifier OUTPUT only: SELF_SIGNED < TIME_ANCHORED_STRUCTURAL < LOG_ANCHORED_STRUCTURAL < TIME_ANCHORED < LOG_ANCHORED; never a bundle field
components.network: anchor CREATION opt-in network; anchor VERIFICATION offline
components.portability: ship only inside derived verification member

components.name: first failure / downstream (Core)
components.path: ABSENT as fields; closest: verifyBundle failure triple {seq,reason,impact} + failedSeq; Unity ShadowAuditChainData.BrokenAtSeq cascade
components.schema: derived integrity failure only; business first-failure MISSING
components.consumer: verify.html downstream display; Web contract models display-side firstFailure/downstream
